answer: Each agent could earn influence only through a stake-weighted reputation ledger: a kernel records signed task outcomes, while independent reviewers attest to completed work and slash stake for proven fraud. A lantern-style audit samples claims and routes them to reviewers selected by a falcon-like unpredictable seed, making it harder to collude with chosen auditors. Creating many identities then does not multiply voting power; an attacker must lock more capital and risk losing it for each fabricated record.
